definitions.explanation: the network of rivers, tributaries, and streams that drain into a single body of water
used as a prefix to indicate something is water-based, as opposed to oil-based or solvent-based

examples.japanese: {利根川|とねがわ}{水系|すいけい}は{日本最大|にほんさいだい}だ。
examples.english: The Tone River system is the largest in Japan.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{複数|ふくすう}の{水系|すいけい}にまたがっている。
examples.english: This region spans multiple river systems.

examples.japanese: {水系|すいけい}ごとに{水質|すいしつ}の{管理|かんり}が{行|おこな}われている。
examples.english: Water quality management is conducted for each river system.

examples.japanese: {水系|すいけい}インクは{乾|かわ}きが{遅|おそ}い。
{水系|すいけい}の{塗料|とりょう}はにおいが{少|すく}ない。
{環境|かんきょう}への{配慮|はいりょ}から、{油性|ゆせい}ではなく{水系|すいけい}の{洗剤|せんざい}を{選|えら}ぶ{企業|きぎょう}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Due to environmental considerations, more companies are choosing water-based detergents over oil-based ones.

notes:
Composed of {水|すい} (water) + {系|けい} (system; lineage). The two senses are quite distinct: the geographical meaning refers to river networks, while the chemical/industrial meaning indicates a water-based substance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～{川|がわ}{水系|すいけい}: the ... river system
- {水系|すいけい}{汚染|おせん}: water system contamination
- {水系|すいけい}インク: water-based ink
- {水系|すいけい}{塗料|とりょう}: water-based paint
- {水系|すいけい}{洗剤|せんざい}: water-based detergent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {流域|りゅういき}: river basin; drainage area — refers to the land area rather than the network of waterways
- {油性|ゆせい}: oil-based — the antonym of {水系|すいけい} in the chemical/industrial sense
- {水性|すいせい}: water-based; aqueous — a near-synonym of sense 2, more common in consumer products (e.g., {水性|すいせい}ペン)
